description: This source file defines interfaces and classes related to circular state testing within an Orleans grain interface context. It includes the ICircularStateTestGrain interface and serializable classes CircularStateTestState, CircularTest1, and CircularTest2, which represent a circular reference structure used for testing serialization and grain state management.

classes.name: CircularStateTestState
classes.description: Serializable class encapsulating the CircularTest1 object, used as grain state.

classes.name: CircularTest1
classes.description: Serializable class containing a reference to CircularTest2, forming part of the circular state structure.

classes.name: CircularTest2
classes.description: Serializable class holding a list of CircularTest1 objects, completing the circular reference cycle.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Async method returning the current CircularTest1 state within the grain.
